title: A Book That Speaks Without Its Author (teaser v1 — REJECTED)

objective.value: Show that around 1440 printing let a book be copied exactly, hundreds of times, with no scribe re-copying it and no author present — so a book could speak to thousands of people its writer never met.
objective.rationale: The piece's own T-17 learning sentence, stated in its script doc before the draft: the objective was set at development, in the doc, and is recorded here as the piece's own — what v1 was trying to do. The owner's verdict attacked the execution (signature phrases, no wow/suspense, sequential delivery), not this aim: the successor's rewrite (teaser-print-v2) kept the same objective in substance.
objective.source: script draft (files/short-eo-teaser-print-script-draft.md — 'The one thing the viewer learns (T-17)' + Phase 0 mini study brief)
objective.record: Decided as a record of the piece's own development (drafted 2026-10-23). NO catalogue objectives-audit row exists for this piece — the objectives audit (hidden_files/objectives-2026-10-24/catalogue-objectives.md) rows teaser-print-v2, not v1 (checked directly at this migration); the objective therefore rests on the script doc alone and NO audit grade is claimed for it. Migration decision, 2026-10-26 (JOB MIGRATION-30): the objective is recorded from the piece's own brief, labeled as such.

message.value: Around 1440, printing let a book be copied exactly, hundreds of times, with no scribe re-copying it and no author present — so a book could speak to thousands of people its writer never met. Essence (≤8 words): 'The book outran its author.'
message.rationale: The script doc's T-17 learning sentence and essence, carried verbatim: the message the draft was built to land (its N-09 close, L7, states it in direct words).
message.record: Decided as a record of the piece's own development. The message itself survived the rejection — v2's T-17 restates it ('…a book stopped needing its author — or any hand — in the room'); what the verdict killed was this draft's way of delivering it.

Deliberately NOT the series' And–But–Therefore spine — a declared variation.
story_structure.rationale: Declared in the narrative declaration (N-04) before the draft existed and executed as declared: the declaration, the per-line jobs table and the Chekhov table all run on this skeleton.

rejection_verdict.value: REJECTED by Hadi, 2026-10-23 — scored 10/100 at his ear as board Action #18 (closed as fail). A full rewrite was ordered — not a line fix. This piece is not a production candidate in any form, and this package is its rejection record, not a development package.
rejection_verdict.rationale: The owner's ear verdict on the delivered script. His attack list, as recorded: (1) SIGNATURE PHRASES — L7's 'Say it plainly:' announcement and L9's stock bridge formula (the board's evidence line: 'signature phrases, no wow, no suspense, sequential delivery'); (2) NO WOW, NO SUSPENSE — sequential information delivery: the facts arrive in order and no beat is owed, so a viewer can leave at any line having lost nothing; the Wiebe storytelling in v1 judged naive/underdeveloped — the gate existing on paper is not the gate passing; (3) RETENTION REASONING ABSENT — v1 carried no click/continue Decision Records (the title had no DR-1 record — the context audit marks the title random for exactly that reason).
rejection_verdict.source: Hadi's verdict, 2026-10-23 (board Action #18); recorded in ~/memory/2026-10-23.md ('Printing teaser — Action #18 verdict: 10/100 REJECTED'); board record checklist item 'Hadi verdict / score' (status fail); successor's script doc (files/short-eo-teaser-print-script-v2.md — header + §7)
rejection_verdict.record: DECIDED-negative — the decisive field of this package. The ruling produced three standing laws the same day (daily log 2026-10-23, also in MEMORY.md): (1) ANTI-SIGNATURE RULE — repeated transition/catch phrases across videos banned ('say it plainly', the 'simple, honest' family are flagged tics); N-09's direct-words close stays but WITHOUT a stock announcing phrase. (2) RETENTION REASONING IN THE DECISION RECORD — every piece's context must rationalize the click (title + thumbnail why) and the continue (first sentence/section whys — hook, suspense, payoff schedule); mismatch = fail. (3) WOW/SUSPENSE IS STRUCTURAL — sequential information delivery fails; scripts need a designed impact (sourced statistic/scale/fold-increase or comparison) where the material supports it. Hadi's standing orders for the teaser lane, as the sibling rewrite records them (files/short-eo-teaser-speech-script-v2.md header): 'no signature phrases, no stock bridges, sourced wow/suspense, retention reasoning logged.' The verdict also ordered the successor into existence the same day (see successor).
